title: sfn_wrap_vectors.rs test-oracle u32 addition can overflow (latent; mirror production wrapping_add)
description: Found during cdwm edge-cases review (kimi-k3). rust/lichen-node/tests/sfn_wrap_vectors.rs:231 and :371 compute (slot as u32 + delta) with plain +, where delta is a full u32 from sfn_delta. A future vector with a large delta (the corpus already contains sfn_delta_apparent_backward = 4294967206) would panic in debug builds if it flowed into these expressions. Production TdmaScheduler::slot_for uses wrapping_add (tdma_scheduler.rs:23); the test oracle should mirror it. Latent only: current hardcoded pairs and the continuity vector use deltas <= 50, so it cannot trigger today. Fix: use wrapping_add in both oracle expressions.
close_reason: Both oracle expressions (sfn_wrap_vectors.rs:233, :373) now use wrapping_add, mirroring production tdma_scheduler.rs:23 — a future large-delta vector can no longer panic the test in debug builds. 19/19 tests pass. 3x codereview delegated to kimi-k3: correctness PASS (bit-identical on all current vector inputs), security PASS (no assertion weakened; external vector anchors untouched), edge-cases PASS with 1 latent finding: the (slot+delta)%N oracle identity is exact only for power-of-two N — comment corrected to state the precondition, and the pre-existing property (also at :349) filed as new P3 bead.
